name: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
description: The Octonauts expand their exploration beyond the sea -- and onto land! With new rides and new friends, they'll protect any habitats and animals at risk.

videos.title: The Octonauts and the Skeleton Coast Adventure
videos.overview: The Octonauts shipwreck on a desert coast and meet water scientist monkey Paani, who leads them to thirsty animals in need of major hydration.

videos.title: The Octonauts and the Land of Fire and Ice
videos.overview: Dashi and Peso round up a reindeer herd when lava causes floods in Iceland.

videos.title: The Octonauts and the Beetle Invasion
videos.overview: Kwazii and grandad Calico Jack find a new island home for a band of beetles.

videos.title: The Octonauts and the Wild Windstorms
videos.overview: Dashi whips through wild winds in Antarctica to rescue Calico Jack.

videos.title: The Octonauts and the Siberian Salamander
videos.overview: Professor Inkling and Paani help a hibernating salamander avoid a harmful gas.

videos.title: The Octonauts and the Hot Spring Snake
videos.overview: Dashi, Tweak and Tunip search for hot springs after mudslides force a snake out of his home.

videos.title: The Octonauts and the Devil's Hole Pupfish
videos.overview: The Octonauts help hungry pupfish find their algae snack.

videos.title: The Octonauts and the Australian Outback Mystery
